thread:
emily: Heads-up  contractor-starting-as-engineer (OPT, EAD card)  Anais (she/her) on OPT sent EAD images but kiosk says 'document type unsupported'. Start date Friday. Need I-9 intake and benefits eligibility Q&A (contractor vs W-2).

scott: Hiring manager here. We need Anais to start Friday remotely. Can ppl-ops accept EAD card scans manually? Also contractor vs employee decision is already set: shes joining as a 1099 contractor for 3 months. Confirm benefits ineligible?

ppl-ops-bot: policy-ref: contractor-onboarding -> "1099 contractors are not eligible for standard benefits or equity. For short-term contractors <6mo, benefits enrollment suppressed. If reclassified to W-2, re-enroll during open enrollment or qualifying event."

jon: For I-9, an EAD (Form I-766) is acceptable as List A document but remote-evidence needs a clear front/back + selfie. Kiosk accepts jpeg/pdf <10MB; HEIC sometimes rejected. If portal fails, ppl-ops can ingest manually with audit note.

emily: Anais tried to upload via mobile; portal rejected with "unsupported doc type". I asked her to convert to PDF and resend. If that fails, we'll do manual ingest.

itbot: Received manual attachment: anaisead_front.jpg (2.4MB), anaisead_back.jpg (1.9MB), selfie.jpg (0.9MB). Attempting portal upload... portal error: "file encoding mismatch (HEIC->jpg)".

jon: Ok I'll run a sanitize: `magick anaisead_front.jpg -strip -interlace Plane -quality 88 anaisead_front_sanitized.pdf` then upload.

itbot: Sanitized and uploaded successfully. Portal accepted I-9 docs. bg-bot: background-check kicked off; vendor flagged name variant (two last names).

bg-bot: background-check: alias detected: "Anais Martinez-Lopez" vs provided "Anais Martinez". Vendor requests confirmation of full legal name (as on EAD) and any prior names.

emily: EAD shows Martinez-Lopez. Anais confirms Martinez-Lopez is legal name (hyphenated). She used Martinez on the hire form accidentally. I've asked her to confirm via reply.

ana (via ppl-ops-bot): Please confirm legal name matches payroll docs. If contractor, payroll needs tax form 1099 details and SSN/TIN. If on OPT with SSN, provide SSN to payroll.

finance-bot: Contractor pay setup: we need invoice cadence and W-9 if US-person. If on OPT with SSN, she is a US person for tax. W-9 required. If she lacks SSN, need ITIN and extra steps.

emily: Anais replied: "Confirmed legal name Anais Martinez-Lopez, SSN provided via secure form; will send W-9."

scott: Great. For day-1 access, request provisional non-prod access only (no prod creds). IT can ship laptop or allow pickup from SF office. Anais is in LA and can pick up.

itbot: Laptop: available for pickup at SF office EOD Thu if Anais brings ID. For remote pickup we require appointment. Shipping available overnight if not picked up. Provisioned scoped temp access ticket created: onboard-2680005555-temp.

ppl-ops-bot: Summary: I-9 accepted after manual sanitize & upload; BG vendor awaiting name confirmation (submitted); contractor classification confirmed (1099) -> benefits suppressed; payroll needs W-9 (received? pending); provisional scoped access granted for day-1; laptop pickup/shipping options provided. Closing thread unless blocked.

emily: Thanks team. I'll confirm W-9 receipt and post an update here tomorrow AM. :relaxed:
